name: Amazon Elastic Transcoder
overview: Amazon Elastic Transcoder historically provided cloud media transcoding; AWS announced end of support in November 2025 and points customers to AWS Elemental MediaConvert.
examSignals: For current AWS media transcoding, evaluate AWS Elemental MediaConvert rather than launching new Elastic Transcoder workflows

compareWith.diff: MediaConvert is the current AWS managed file-based video processing service and migration destination for Elastic Transcoder workloads.
